name: Tin Hermit
description: Original gacha-style figure: a coral hermit crab living in a sardine-style tin lying on its side. Peeled-back lid with a curl and ring pull, an invented sea label (sardine school, waves), rolled seams, rivets and dents; googly eyes on banded stalks, a little coral claw and an oversized mechanical claw improvised from can scraps (gunmetal, tin, rivets, a brass hinge pin and gear). It sits on a sandy display base.
author: lowpix example
